name: temsor API
description:
Turkish-domain data APIs plus a growing archive of public time series, and voice/call-ops agent tooling (orchestration · promises · search · handoff). Most endpoints are deterministic and answer in single-digit milliseconds. Idle $0 when quiet; no invented live PSTN.

Every success carries the same envelope: `{ ok, data, meta }`. Every failure: `{ ok:false, error:{code,message} }`.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer fk_live_…` or `x-api-key`. Calls without a key work on a narrow per-IP demo quota, so you can try any endpoint before signing up.

**Plans:** Free free — 500 credits, 1 rps · Starter $19/mo — 50,000 credits, 10 rps · Pro $79/mo — 300,000 credits, 30 rps · Scale $299/mo — 2,000,000 credits, 100 rps
